published_prior_art.cite: CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 identifies the latent law and errors, but not an outcome-weighted channel or causal ratio.
KatoSasakiUra2021 gives a density confidence-set architecture without a coupled ADRF-ratio diameter or this logarithmic sup-norm modulus.
KatoSasaki2019 gives a uniform EIV regression band with validation/symmetric-repeat error recovery and ordinary-smooth inversion, not blind nonidentical open-zero replicates.
CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 perturbs the latent density; LouniciNickl2011 treats a known operator. Neither gives the fixed-treatment-marginal Bernoulli outcome experiment.
Low1997 supplies the generic coverage-to-length reduction but not this blind-operator ADRF modulus; no published all-honest ADRF-width converse was located.
HuangZhang2023, Section 2, identifies the known-error ADRF by a weighted conditional expectation and known-error Fourier deconvolution.
Low1997 concerns adaptation barriers and CapitaoMiniconiGassiatLehericy2025 adapts point estimation, but neither characterizes honest adaptation across blind operator-strength subclasses.

novelty_flags.label: Proposition 6: known-error reduction
novelty_flags.one_line: This is a useful sanity reduction, but its known-error ADRF/deconvolution content is already covered by HuangZhang2023 and should be retained only as a labelled benchmark corollary, not counted as novelty.

soundness_flags.label: Definitions of empirical transforms, critical value, and confidence set
soundness_flags.one_line: The procedure is undefined on allowed samples with n_x=0 and at zero-empirical-variance channels (including the deterministic F channel at frequency (0,0)); specify defaults and omit or define deterministic self-normalized coordinates.

soundness_flags.label: ass:weighted-sobolev
soundness_flags.one_line: LouniciNickl2011 studies a latent density under a known convolution operator, not a standard outcome-weighted signed channel; retag this load-bearing condition as novel and justify it from primitive response/density regularity, or cite an exact source.

soundness_flags.label: ass:error-moment
soundness_flags.one_line: The q0>=8 envelope is stronger than the stated coupled ECF construction needs: its sampled channels are bounded, compact-support continuation concerns f and q, and centering already supplies the moment needed for normalization; remove it or state the proof step that requires order eight.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 476-479, Section 2, equations (1)-(7), especially equation (2) and the known-characteristic-function premise preceding it
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article assumes a known measurement-error characteristic function, identifies the ADRF through a weighted conditional expectation, and then applies deconvolution-kernel inversion.

source_verification_receipts.version: Annals of Statistics 39(1), 2011, version of record
source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 201, abstract and opening model statement
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies sup-norm risk for estimating the density f of an unobserved signal X under a known convolution error law, with smoothness classes for that density; it does not establish a standard Sobolev condition for a signed outcome-weighted channel q.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the band construction total: define behavior when a stratum is empty, remove deterministic coordinates from the multiplier maximum, and state the zero-variance convention before claiming expected width over the full model.

Replace the standalone Sobolev condition on q with primitive sufficient conditions on the response curve and f, or explicitly present it as a realistic new response-regularity class and prove the rate under that class.
Either eliminate q0>=8 or expose the exact derivative/empirical-process bound requiring it; retaining only the minimal moment condition will make the proposed blind model materially more credible.

Sharpen the adaptation OEQ by naming nested subclasses through an observable lower-envelope modulus and a candidate separation functional, so its necessary-and-sufficient frontier has a concrete focal object.

recommended_next_step: Repair the total-definition and assumption audit defects, recast Proposition 6 as a benchmark corollary, then advance the surviving matched blind-ADRF band kernel to Stage 0.
